pre_date_header: Articled Assistant at Rajiv Rajeev & Associates, Ludhiana, Punjab
bullets: A well-known CA firm having 25 years of presence in Ludhiana offering services to 150+ clients like Statutory Audits, Tax Audits, personalized tax planning, GST and Bank Audits.

Performed Statutory Audits and Tax Audits for clients across various industries like manufacturing, trading and service sector having turnover of more than ₹ 50 Crores, conducted in-depth ledger scrutiny, substantive audit procedures, vouching and verification, ensuring compliance with Standards on Auditing (SAs), Accounting Standards (AS), The Companies Act, 2013, The Income Tax Act, 1961, and other relevant laws.

Worked closely with principal to conduct Statutory Branch Audits of public sector banks, including audit planning, performing audit procedures for test of controls across significant areas such as cash, valuable stationery items like FDRs, DDs, cheque leaves, and fixed assets, contributing to the preparation of the Long Form Audit Report (LFAR).

Conducted major audit procedures for Statutory Branch Audit of public sector insurance companies, including determination of materiality level for sample selection to test of various types of insurance claims paid, and drafting of auditor’s report.

Performed pre-planning and initial audit engagement procedures, including client background checks, communication with predecessor auditors, drafting of engagement letters and scrutiny of opening balances vis-à-vis audited financial statements of prior period.

Led an engagement team of 3 members to work closely with a manufacturing entity having turnover of more than Rs. 200 crores to verify the correctness of supplementary invoices amounting to Rs. 10 crores for rate differences between sales invoices and purchase orders using advanced Excel functions like IF and VLOOKUP, identifying control gaps in its Procure to Pay (P2P) process, resulting in the recommendation of process improvements.

Performed periodic physical verification of inventories, assessing internal controls, identifying material variances and reporting of audit findings to senior management of various manufacturing and trading entities.

Assisted various clients in preparation and finalisation of books of accounts complying with Accounting Standards (AS) and other relevant tax laws using software like Tally Prime, Evershine etc., resulting in the reduction in audit errors.

Handled work relating to Income Tax Litigations including filing of appeals with Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) and drafting replies to notices of clients amounting to ₹ 50 Lakhs of tax litigation.
Prepared and filed Income Tax Returns for a diverse client base using Income Tax utilities and tax filing software like CompuTax.
Prepared and filed TDS/TCS returns and statements.
Executed filing of GST returns like GSTR-1, GSTR-3B etc. for various clients.
Managed filing form for GSTIN Registration in FORM GST REG-01.
